summary: Indonesia Energy Corporation Limited, a Cayman Islands oil and gas company, furnished a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026, announcing that its K-29 well, spudded July 25, 2026, reached total depth of ~3,378 feet, with perforation intervals submitted to Pertamina for testing preparation. The filing also announced the President's YouTube Live presentation on September 3, 2026. This is a routine operational update and investor communication, not a special situation. No transformative corporate events, deal terms, or strategic changes are involved; it merely reflects ongoing drilling activities and forward-looking statements.
